title: Research on Metabolic Differences and Thiamine Biosynthesis in Various Organisms
summary: This cluster is centered around the study of metabolic differences and thiamine biosynthesis in various organisms. B. Magasanik is involved in the NAD-linked glutamate dehydrogenase gene or protein, while Barrio E's work focuses on metabolic differences. Minebois R's research is related to Peris, and thiamine biosynthetic pathway is connected to both Mol Microbiol and SM Miller. The wild organism is involved in the wine strain, and multi-omic analysis is related to metabolic differences.
